decided: The status readout keeps marking implementation and archiving as steps the user invokes, even when the user's setting lets the AI run them unasked.
alternatives: drop the marker when the setting grants the step
show a different marker for a granted step
why: The setting enters no gate, state, reason, position or next command, so the readout the user reads is the same with or without it; only the status's machine-readable output gains a part saying whether the next command may run unasked. The guide explains that the setting can grant a marked step.

relies_on.title: The chain setting grants each command on its own key
